subject: Mutual plan kickstart — ZenPort renewal, evaluation timeline & uptake
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@zenport.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@zenport.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Oct 2026 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual plan kickstart — ZenPort renewal, evaluation timeline & uptake

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for the time last week. As discussed, I put together a starter mutual action plan (MAP) and a short evaluation timeline so we can align on goals, owners, and the close cadence for the upcoming renewal. Attached: ZenPort_MUTUAL_PLAN_v0.3.xlsx and the usage snapshot for September.

High-level asks in this email:
- Confirm objectives: reduce inference cost per request by 30% while maintaining P95 latency under 250ms for the core search flow.
- Confirm internal owners from your side (technical and procurement).
- Agree on evaluation checkpoints (week 2 pilot, week 4 performance review) and a target close date.

Suggested owners (Redwood):
- Soojin Lee — MAP owner / primary contact
- Marissa Cole — Renewal strategy & adoption playbook
- Karthik Iyer — Solutions / pilot enablement
- Rishi Malhotra — Renewal commercial lead

Suggested next step: 30-min kickoff to walk the MAP and lock owners. I’m available Wed 21 Oct 10:00–12:00 PT or Thu 22 Oct 14:00–16:00 PT. If those don’t work, propose a slot.

Notes on attachments: the MAP has line items for pilot scope, success criteria, and a proposed upsell sequence (dedicated capacity trial -> reserved commit conversation). We can prune items during the call.

Thanks,
Soojin

--
Soojin Lee
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachment: ZenPort_MUTUAL_PLAN_v0.3.xlsx (spreadsheet)
Attachment: zenport-usage-sep2026.pdf (PDF)

From: Alex Morgan <alex.morgan@zenport.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@zenport.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Oct 2026 11:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Mutual plan kickstart — ZenPort renewal, evaluation timeline & uptake

Thanks Soojin — appreciate the clear draft. Quick points from our side:

1) Owners: I’ll be the exec sponsor, Priya will be procurement lead. We’ll add a technical owner (I’ll confirm a name by EOD Wed).
2) Timeline: Can we tighten the pilot to complete by the end of week 2 (rather than week 3)? We have a board review window the week of Nov 8 and moving things earlier helps.
3) Success criteria look good — one addition: validate tokenization parity for our pretokenized inputs (we’ll share a short sample).

I’m available Wed 21 Oct 10:00 PT for the kickoff — let’s lock that.

Best,
Alex

--
Alex Morgan | Director, Platform Engineering
ZenPort Inc.
alex.morgan@zenport.com | (415) 555-9988

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Oct 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Mutual plan kickstart — ZenPort renewal, evaluation timeline & uptake

Great — thank you all for the quick responses. Recap and updated asks: 

1) Kickoff confirmed: Wed, 21 Oct 2026, 10:00 PT (calendar invite sent).
2) Pilot scope: search + recommendation pipelines only. Target pilot end: two weeks from kickoff (EOD Wed, 4 Nov 2026).
3) Success criteria: 30% cost reduction objective; P95 latency < 250ms; tokenization parity validation.
4) Owners:
   - Exec sponsor: Alex Morgan (ZenPort)
   - Procurement: Priya Singh (ZenPort)
   - MAP owner (Redwood): Soojin Lee
   - Adoption / upsell: Marissa Cole
   - Solutions / pilot enablement: Karthik Iyer
   - Commercial / pricing: Rishi Malhotra, support from Marcus Lin

5) Deliverables and deadlines:
   - ZenPort to share tokenization sample and test data by Mon, 26 Oct.
   - Redwood to run initial performance baseline by Tue, 27 Oct and share results.
   - Interim review (checkpoint): Fri, 30 Oct (30-minute sync).
   - Target sign-off for moving to reserved commit conversation: Tue, 7 Nov.

Marissa and Marcus — please draft the pricing sketch and the short upsell sequencing doc by Mon, 26 Oct so we can review on the 30th. Alex/Priya — please confirm technical owner name when you have it.

If there are no objections I’ll mark the MAP as v0.4 and upload the final to the Drive link.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to the kickoff.

Soojin

--
Soojin Lee
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
